description: Record the candidates you reviewed or delivered on a named, account-owned list, then pass that name as search_developers' excludeList so a rerun of the same brief never returns them again. Idempotent: replaying a partial run double-counts nothing. The list is created by whichever of this tool or claim_seen_logins runs first, so a fresh brief needs no setup call. Costs 0 credits.

githubIds.description: Optional { login: githubId } map for stable identity dedup across renames.

list.description: List name, 1-64 chars of a-z, 0-9, '-' or '_'. Created on first write, subject to your plan's list cap.

logins.description: GitHub logins to record, max 500 per call. An empty array only creates the list.

name: add_seen_logins
title: Record logins on a seen list
